notes: The official DroidKaigi 2026 conference app (Play Store and App Store; the conference ran 1–3 September 2026). It is rebuilt from scratch every year by a large contributor group working to a design the conference's own designers produce, which is why a conference app earns a place beside the products here. :core:ui is the design-system module — KaigiChip, KaigiSegmentedButton, KaigiTextField, the timetable card, the profile card, and this year's hand-drawn Sketch and Doodle primitives. Counted in a checkout: 60 @Preview functions, all in core/ui/src/commonMain importing androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview. The first build proved the lane: with renderer: android the spec pre-flight passed and then :core:ui:composePreviewRender failed with "90 capture(s) were drawn and none produced a file. That is a renderer or classpath fault rather than a broken preview" — the Robolectric lane drew every capture and wrote none of them. So this renders on the DESKTOP lane instead, which is available because droidkaigi.primitive.kmp declares jvm() (jvmMain exists in this module) and every preview is in commonMain, with nothing Android-only to lose. It is also the lane closest to how this project runs itself: the repository ships app-desktop. previewAnnotations names LocalePreviews and LocaleScreenPreviews, the bilingual multipreviews declared over in :core:common: without them a source scan sees 34 of the 60 and fails every spec entry that names one of the other 26. Two other things a reviewer should know: several previews take their colour scheme through @PreviewParameter(KaigiSchemeProvider::class), and the repository is retired after the conference — the 2027 app is a NEW repository, so this import follows main until it goes quiet and is then either pinned or re-pointed. Apache-2.0.
